name: final-capstone
description: MediTrack healthcare portal - MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js + Python AI service

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && node scripts/python.js install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB,AI -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "node scripts/python.js run"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,AI -c green,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "node scripts/python.js run"
